message: The last storm left us without power for a couple of days, and I found myself rediscovering the joy of board games with the grandkids. Who knew a little friendly competition over Monopoly could be so much fun? It reminded me that sometimes, the best prep isn't just about flashlights and batteries, but also about having a good old-fashioned plan for entertainment. What’s your favorite low-tech way to pass the time when the weather gets rough?
